allowed: G1 regression tier (50 synthetic DEV cases, zsprod/g1c)
A1 cohort (26 runnable scans, 14 SKUs; pc_b4719db3dd69 BLOCKED)
E2E part 10839000 (= A1 DEV-EA3E4820DF: full, scan_1, scan_2)
inputs.mirrors: scan coordinates (and normals) negated in one axis, winding reversed; x, y, z separately

limits.slots: sherman_slot.sh, at most 2 concurrent, nice 10, OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
limits.engine_limits: 180 s timeout, 170 s budget, K=2 resample net (production)

q1_cad_10839000.distinguishing_features: one ~15 x 28 mm rectangular cutout in the side wall at y~49 mm, absent from the opposite wall (y~361 mm); 4 small holes per wall are mirror-symmetric (<= 2.2 mm edge offsets under the 180 deg fit)
q1_cad_10839000.stages: every formed stage S1-S12 keeps the cutout (cluster ~1080 points > 1.5 mm); S0 flat is achiral
q1_cad_10839000.verdict: CHIRAL (by one cutout): a mirrored 10839000 is a different part; VALID on it is wrong

q2_trace_10839000_full_scan_x_mirror.compile: A1 compile DEV-EA3E4820DF (the E2E used its own wizard compile; same outcome class)

mirror_check_trigger.rule: hole_mismatch > 0 or explained < 0.85 or datum score < 0.90

q4_fix.name: mirror identity check (prototype, scratch copy only)
q4_fix.in_sample_warning: thresholds were chosen looking at these same G1/A1 runs; a held-out confirmation is required before any release

f1_wrong_part.explanation: a scan with no plane matching the CAD datum returns UNTRUSTED_REGISTRATION (NO_DATUM_PLANE_MATCHED) before the wrong-part tests run; fail-closed, label only
f1_wrong_part.swaps: 13/30 wrong-part swaps end this way; 15 WRONG_PART_SUSPECTED; 1 MIRRORED_PART_SUSPECTED; 1 VALID with nothing measured (44211000_A as 28870000: INCOMPLETE, 0/1 bends, datum score 0.47)
